correctness.rationale: The proof is a finite combinatorial argument with all quantifiers and boundaries explicit. Three extensions of one pair are chosen; intersection forces any edge avoiding that pair to be the triple of extension vertices; positive codegree confines all edges to a five-set; codegree at least three then forces every triple on that set. The converse establishes sharpness.
